jobs.title: Director AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Position Description

CGI is Canada's largest independent information technology services firm, and after 50 years, we continue to grow. We are building a new AI engineering capability within our Toronto Financial Services (TFS) business unit, serving clients across Banking, Insurance, and Wealth Management.

We are looking for a Director, Consulting Services to build and lead this new capability. This is a people leadership role with accountability for the team, delivery, and client relationships. The AI engineering team will report to this role, including Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Co-op, Agentic AI Engineers, Founding AI Engineers, and the Distinguished AI Engineer.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will stay close to the work by building demos, helping shape complex solutions, and setting technical direction alongside the team. As a player-coach, you will develop people, build trusted client relationships, grow the capability, and remain actively engaged in how solutions are designed and built.

This role is hybrid and requires you to work from our downtown Toronto office and/or client office a minimum of two days per week, subject to change at any time.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Build, grow, and lead the AI engineering team, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

Own delivery across client engagements, with accountability for timelines, quality, and business value.

Build and maintain senior client relationships, develop trusted partnerships, grow accounts, and identify new opportunities.

Remain hands-on by building demos and proofs of concept and contributing to complex solutions.

Set technical direction and engineering standards for AI solutions in collaboration with the Distinguished AI Engineer.

Shape AI roadmaps and business cases in collaboration with CGI and client leadership.

Own estimates, budgets, and delivery plans for the team's work.

Maintain high standards for quality, security, and reliability across delivered solutions.

Build an inclusive, collaborative team culture that supports continuous learning and professional growth.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

12+ years of experience in software delivery or consulting, including experience leading teams.

Demonstrated people leadership experience building and leading engineering or delivery teams, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

Strong, current hands-on technical skills, with the ability to build demos and complex full-stack solutions using Java and Node.js and AI coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, or Claude Code.

Strong knowledge of building AI and agent-based products, including prompt, context, harness, and loop engineering.

Demonstrated experience owning client delivery, including estimates, budgets, plans, timelines, and quality.

Experience developing trusted relationships with senior client leaders and identifying opportunities to grow accounts.

Strong technical understanding of APIs, databases including PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and cloud technologies to effectively guide engineering teams.

Ability to connect AI initiatives to defined business outcomes and value.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts clearly to executives, clients, and engineering teams.

Assets

Experience in Banking, Insurance, or Wealth Management.

Experience establishing and growing a new practice or capability.

Consulting or professional services experience.

Public contributions to the AI community through speaking engagements, published writing, or open-source work.

Relevant cloud or delivery certifications, including Azure, AWS, or GCP.

**CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $145,000–$195,000. This role is an existing vacancy.**

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis - SLC Management
jobs.description:
SLC Management is a growing global asset management firm providing innovative and diversified investment solutions to institutional investors. We are breaking new ground with a full spectrum of solutions for a growing institutional client base of more than 1400 organizations. Our history of organic and strategic growth reflects this commitment with over CA$422/US$304 billion in assets under management (AUM). As a subsidiary of Sun Life, we are aligned with one of the world’s leading financial services companies, and benefit from the stability and strength of that relationship.

We are a performance-driven organization with a deliberate focus on fostering a development-focused, inclusive culture revolving around our Core Values of being client obsessed
, valuing each other
, acting with speed
and having an owner’s mindset
. As part of our team, you play a role in fulfilling our purpose and making a difference. We offer a rewarding work environment that is filled with opportunity for growth where you will be empowered to meet the challenges of a highly competitive landscape.

Visit our website to learn more and for the most up to date AUM information.

SLC Management offers a mix of in-office and virtual work where our employees are empowered to do their best. Generally, employees are expected to work three or more days in-office each week with flexibility depending on their business, client and team needs.

Job Description:

Join SLC Management's Toronto-based team as a Director/Senior Director, FP&A in a highly visible role that extends well beyond traditional financial planning and analysis. In addition to leading management reporting, forecasting, and strategic planning, you will support investor relations, financial modeling, business analytics, and corporate strategy across a global alternatives platform. The role offers regular interaction with SLC Management's executive team, business leaders, and Sun Life partners.
This position is ideal for a commercially minded finance leader who combines analytical rigor with sound business judgment and enjoys translating complex data into actionable insights. You will thrive in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment where priorities evolve quickly, continuous learning is expected, and there may be opportunities to lead and develop finance talent.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape the financial and strategic direction of one of the industry's fastest-growing alternatives platforms. As SLC Management continues to expand across private credit, real estate, infrastructure, and fixed income, you will partner directly with senior leadership on critical growth, investment, and business decisions while building a strong platform for future career advancement.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Management reporting — Lead the preparation of monthly and quarterly management reporting packages, including AUM and fee-earning AUM roll-forwards, fee-related earnings, management and performance fee revenue, expenses, margin, and headcount, with clear commentary on drivers, trends, and variances to plan
Planning and forecasting — Own key components of the annual budget, multi-year business plan, and rolling forecast process across business units and corporate functions; partner with business leaders to build, challenge, and validate assumptions
Business and strategic planning — Support the enterprise strategic planning cycle, including long-range financial projections, growth ambition setting, capital allocation analysis, and evaluation of new products, strategies, and investment platforms
Financial modeling — Build and maintain robust, auditable models covering fundraising and deployment pacing, fee revenue build-ups, seed and co-investment capital, expense structures, product-level and client-level profitability, and scenario and sensitivity analysis
Investor relations support — Prepare analysis, talking points, and supporting materials for Sun Life quarterly earnings disclosure, investor day content, analyst questions, and peer benchmarking against publicly traded alternative asset managers
Executive and Board materials — Develop clear, well-structured presentations and written analysis for the SLC Management executive team, Sun Life senior leadership, and Board audiences
Strategy and analytics — Conduct competitive, market, and peer analysis on AUM growth, fee rates, margins, fund performance, and industry trends; deliver insight-driven recommendations rather than data alone
Business partnership — Act as a trusted finance partner to business unit leaders, investment teams, distribution, and corporate functions, supporting ad hoc analysis, business cases, and decision support
Process improvement — Drive continuous improvement in planning tools, reporting templates, data quality, and dashboards to increase speed, accuracy, and insight
Generative AI adoption — Apply generative AI and emerging analytical tools to accelerate and strengthen FP&A work — from research and peer benchmarking to drafting, model documentation, data summarization, and reporting automation — and help establish practical standards for how the team uses these tools responsibly and with appropriate review
Cross-functional collaboration — Work closely with Controllership, Tax, Capital & Treasury, Investor Relations, Human Resources, and Sun Life corporate Finance to ensure consistency and integrity of financial information
Leadership — Where applicable, manage, coach, and develop finance talent, setting clear standards for analytical quality and attention to detail

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED:

Intellectual curiosity – actively seeks to understand what drives the business, asks the next question, and pursues the “why” behind the numbers
Exceptional attention to detail – produces work that is accurate, internally consistent, and executive-ready the first time; treats precision as non-negotiable
Strong business acumen – understands alternative asset management economics, including fee structures, fundraising and deployment cycles, fee-related earnings, carried interest, seed capital, and industry KPIs
Advanced financial modeling – advanced proficiency Excel skills with the ability to build, audit, and maintain complex, well-structured models
Excel and PowerPoint mastery – strong command of Excel is essential, along with the ability to build clean, compelling, executive-ready PowerPoint materials that communicate a clear story
Generative AI fluency and curiosity – hands-on experience applying generative AI to finance or analytical work, or clear aptitude and enthusiasm to adopt it rigorously; understands both the leverage these tools create and the need to validate outputs
Analytical rigour – structured, data-driven problem solver who can move from raw data to a defensible recommendation
Executive communication – distills complexity into clear, concise narratives and presentations for senior leadership, Board, and investor audiences
Stakeholder management – credible and collaborative with senior leaders and cross-functional partners; influences effectively without direct authority
Ownership and drive – self-starter who takes initiative, manages multiple priorities against tight deadlines, and follows through
Thrives in a fast-paced environment – operates effectively under tight deadlines and shifting priorities, maintaining quality and composure when timelines compress
Commitment to continuous learning – continuously builds knowledge of new asset classes, markets, tools, and technologies; treats learning as an ongoing expectation rather than an occasional exercise, and shares that knowledge across the team
Comfort with ambiguity – thrives in a dynamic, integrating, high-growth environment with sound judgement and a solutions-oriented mindset
Integrity and discretion – handles confidential and market-sensitive information with professionalism
Leadership potential – coaches and elevates others

PREFERRED SKILLS:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field
CFA, MBA, or CPA designation is an asset
Approximately 8–12 years of progressive experience in financial planning & analysis, corporate finance, strategy or management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or corporate development
Experience in asset management, alternative investments, or financial services is strongly preferred; familiarity with real estate, private credit, infrastructure, or fixed income strategies is a distinct advantage
Demonstrated career progression, with a track record of increasing responsibility, strong performance, and measurable impact
Proven experience preparing analysis and materials for senior executive, Board, or investor audiences
Experience partnering across multiple business units and corporate functions in a matrixed organization
Prior people leadership or mentorship experience is preferred
Strong, demonstrable proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint is required — advanced modeling in Excel and executive-quality presentation building in PowerPoint; experience with enterprise planning and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Anaplan, Hyperion, OneStream, Tableau) is an asset
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot or comparable platforms) to improve analytical output, research, or productivity is preferred; genuine curiosity to apply them more rigorously is essential

Why SLC Management?

Opportunity to work for a growing global institutional asset manager
Excellent benefits and wellness programs to support the three pillars of your well-being – mental, physical and financial – including generous vacation and sick time, market-leading maternity, parental and adoption leave top up program, a partially-paid sabbatical program and much more
Pension, stock and savings programs with an employer-paid match to help build and enhance your future financial security
A flexible work environment with a friendly, caring, collaborative and inclusive culture focused on career growth development #WeWinAsATeam
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential
Award winning workplace culture - Great Place to Work® Certified in Canada and the U.S., “Best Places to Work” by Glassdoor, Award for Excellence for Mental Health at Work, “Best Places to Work in Money Management” by Pension & Investments

SLC Management is a regulated business, and this means that there are certain financial reporting and trading preclearance requirements for all employees. Successful candidates will be required to declare personal investment accounts and securities investments as well as seek preclearance on future transactions including those of household members.

Job Category:

Finance

Salary Range

110,000/110 000 - 180,000/180 000

We are committed to pay transparency and equity. The base salary range for this role is competitive and we strive to ensure that compensation is fair and equitable. Your actual base salary will be determined by your unique skills, qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive award based on individual and overall business performance along with a broad range of competitive benefits.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees feel they belong, are supported and empowered to thrive. We are dedicated to building teams with varied experiences, backgrounds perspectives and ideas that benefit our colleagues, clients, and the communities where we operate. We encourage applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations. Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process or those needing job postings in an alternative format may e-mail a request to thebright

jobs.title: VP, Information Services
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Vice President, Information Services to lead the next stage of growth and operational maturity within Calian's enterprise technology environment.

As Calian continues to grow through both organic expansion and acquisitions, this role will ensure Information Services can scale alongside the business while delivering reliable services, operational excellence, and a strong employee experience.

Reporting to the Chief Information and Technology Officer (CITO), the Vice President is responsible for translating technology strategy into business results through strong operational leadership, scalable services, and disciplined execution. You will oversee the Information Services organization, including enterprise applications, infrastructure, service delivery, enterprise architecture, project portfolio management, vendor partnerships, and technology planning.

This is a leadership opportunity for someone who enjoys building high-performing teams, solving operational challenges, driving meaningful change, and delivering measurable business outcomes. Success will come from improving service delivery, strengthening organizational effectiveness, reducing operational friction, and positioning Information Services to support Calian's future growth.

Responsibilities

Provide executive leadership for the Information Services function, ensuring technology services and capabilities effectively support business priorities and growth objectives.
Translate technology strategy into operational plans, scalable services, and measurable business outcomes.
Lead enterprise applications, infrastructure, end-user services, enterprise architecture, and technology operations.
Drive operational excellence through improved service delivery, employee experience, organizational effectiveness, and continuous improvement.
Partner with business leaders to support modernization, automation, digital transformation, and business enablement initiatives.
Oversee technology planning, project portfolio governance, delivery performance, and value realization.
Support mergers and acquisitions through technology due diligence, integration planning, and onboarding activities.
Manage technology budgets, strategic vendor relationships, contracts, and investment priorities.
Partner closely with Cybersecurity & Governance to ensure technology services align with security, compliance, privacy, and enterprise risk requirements.
Build and develop a high-performing leadership team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer service, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive leadership experience across Information Systems, Technology organizations, enterprise applications, infrastructure, service delivery, and digital transformation.
Experience leading multiple enterprise technology functions within a large, complex, and growth-oriented organization.
Strong understanding of enterprise applications, ERP, CRM, HRIS, M365, infrastructure, cloud services, networking, end-user computing, and IT service management.
Demonstrated success translating technology strategy into operational execution and measurable business outcomes.
Proven experience improving service delivery, operational performance, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness through scalable processes, technology, and people leadership.
Experience leading large-scale transformation programs, modernization initiatives, and organizational change.
Demonstrated ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer service, and continuous improvement.
Strong stakeholder management and business partnership skills, with the ability to build credibility, influence decisions, and establish trusted relationships across all levels of an organization.
Proven success managing enterprise budgets, strategic vendors, contracts, and technology investments.
Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, and technology integration activities.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and enterprise risk concepts, with the ability to effectively partner with governance and security teams.
Ability to balance long-term strategic planning with disciplined operational execution in a dynamic and evolving environment.
Exceptional communication, leadership, change management, and relationship-building skills.
Demonstrated track record of accountability, follow-through, and delivering on commitments.
Experience operating in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment supporting organizational expansion and acquisition activity.
Commitment to customer service, collaboration, continuous improvement, and business partnership.
Ability to lead through change while building trust, credibility, and strong relationships across the organization.

Additional Requirements

Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret level security clearance.
Ability to work from the Ottawa office on a regular basis.

Compensation

Compensation will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, leadership scope, and overall expertise. Calian offers a competitive executive compensation program and comprehensive total rewards package, including short-term and long-term incentive opportunities.

Position Type

We have 1 full-time permanent position available.

Perks And Benefits

Competitive, company-paid benefits
Generous time off package
Stock purchase plan
RRSP program
Flexible work hours for eligible roles
Programs to support employee health and well-being
